result.topic_en: Riemann rewrites the one-dimensional gas-motion equations in terms of the characteristic quantities p and q (Riemann invariants), switches to p and q as independent variables to obtain a linear equation for a potential w, and discusses the exceptional cases where ∂p/∂x or ∂q/∂x vanish.

(1) $\frac{\partial u}{\partial t}+u\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=-a^2\frac{\partial\log\varrho}{\partial x}$
und $\frac{\partial\log\varrho}{\partial t}+u\frac{\partial\log\varrho}{\partial x}=-\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}$
[-Diese Gleichungen erhalten eine einfachere Gestalt-]
Wenn man die zweite Gleichung mit $\pm a$ multiplicirt,
zur ersten addirt und zur Abkürzung [-setzt-]

(3) $\frac{\partial p}{\partial t}=-(u+a)\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}$ $\frac{\partial q}{\partial t}=-(u-a)\frac{\partial q}{\partial x}$
Aus ihnen folgt
(4) $dp=\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}(dx-(u+a)dt)$ oder da $u=2a(p+q)$ [?]
$=\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}(d(x-\overline{u+a}\,t)+2at(dp+dq))$
(5) $dq=\frac{\partial q}{\partial x}(d(x-\overline{u-a}\,t)+2at(dp+dq))$
[-Wenn man daher p und q-] [-Wenn daher $\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}$-]

[-Es ergiebt sich [?]-] In Folge derselben ist
(6) $(x-\overline{u+a}\,t)dp+(x-\overline{u-a}\,t)dq$
ein vollständiges Differential, {+dessen Integral w der Gleichung+} [-...-]

Wenn $\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}=0$ ist, so {+ergiebt sich [?]+} [-folgt-] aus (4) $dp=0$ und

methods.what: One-dimensional isothermal gas equations (momentum and continuity) in terms of u and log ρ
Definition of Riemann invariants p, q by combining the equations with ±a
Characteristic (diagonal) form: p and q are transported with speeds u+a and u−a
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial p}{\partial t}=-(u+a)\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}$ $\frac{\partial q}{\partial t}=-(u-a)\frac{\partial q}{\partial x}$

methods.what: Differential relations for dp, dq along the flow
Hodograph transformation: p, q as independent variables gives linear equations for x, t
Exact differential defining potential w and the linear second-order equation it satisfies
methods.quote: $-2at=\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial p\partial q}=\frac{\partial w}{\partial p}-\frac{\partial w}{\partial q}$

methods.what: Exceptional case analysis when ∂p/∂x or ∂q/∂x vanishes (simple waves / constant state)
methods.quote:
Wenn endlich $\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}$ und $\frac{\partial q}{\partial x}$ beide $=0$ sind, so werden
in Folge der Diffgl. p und q und w constant.
